why: Golden vectors for ADMISSION: which runtime x capability pair the question consultant may run, and
with which flag. Both halves decide this — CapabilityMatrix.Admit in coai-mcp (the server refuses a
row the matrix refuses) and capabilityAdmission.ts in the extension (the settings tab disables the
pair) — and the two ship separately, so a pair one admits and the other refuses is a row the panel
lets a person save and the server never launches, with nothing on either side saying so (A3).
Each side answers EVERY vector with its own loader over shared/runtime-capabilities.json: `admitted`
and `flag` are the decision, `standing` is the row it was made from. A runtime or capability neither
file knows must be refused by name, which is why the last vectors are not in the table at all.
The reason SENTENCES are each side's own; what must never differ is the decision.
